phases.title: Admit Source-Backed BoM Evidence
entryCriteria: Architecture is reviewable enough to identify critical component candidates.
exitCriteria: Every critical BoM line has admitted supplier, manufacturer, MPN, unit cost and source reference.
BoM provenance manifest has zero critical missing-source claims.
phases.rationale: Critical BoM costs, suppliers, manufacturers and MPNs must be source-backed before cost claims are credible.

phases.title: Complete Engineering Review
entryCriteria: Calculations and assumptions have named scope, formula or model basis.
exitCriteria: All calculation and assumption review rows are accepted, revised or explicitly deferred with reviewer rationale.
phases.rationale: Deterministic arithmetic can expose claims, but engineering judgment must review envelopes, assumptions and operating cases.

topRows.issue: Medical electrical equipment safety reference is relevant to this product class in Global / medical device.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Electrical safety, leakage, power source and abnormal-operation evidence tailored to wearable use.

topRows.issue: Medical-device software lifecycle is relevant to this product class in Global / medical device.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Software architecture, risk class, verification and release evidence.

topRows.issue: Biological evaluation of patient-contacting materials is relevant to this product class in Global / medical device.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Skin-contact material, adhesive and wear-duration biocompatibility evidence.

topRows.issue: Medical-device risk management is relevant to this product class in Global / medical device.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Hazard analysis, risk controls and residual-risk acceptability.

topRows.issue: Sensor wear duration uses wear_days with medium confidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Review the formula, input values and operating envelope before treating this metric as a performance claim.

topRows.issue: MARD Accuracy Target currently evaluates as pass against <=10% MARD target before clinical validation; 10-15% needs strong use-case constraints, >15% is weak for dosing-adjacent use.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Biofluid/Signal Closure currently evaluates as pass against interstitial fluid path, electrode signal, sensor signal bus and calibration data bus present.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Patch/Power/Comms/Safety Closure currently evaluates as pass against adhesive skin boundary, sterile boundary, BLE link, low-power rail, alarm bus and disposable applicator present.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Reading Interval currently evaluates as pass against 1 to 15 minute reading intervals for wearable trend monitoring before battery and radio duty-cycle evidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: Wear Duration currently evaluates as pass against 7 to 15 days for common disposable CGM patch wear; longer wear needs adhesive, biocompatibility and sensor-drift evidence.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Supply an engineering calculation, reviewer note, test plan or datasheet-backed rationale for this envelope.

topRows.issue: 4032 readings over the stated wear period.
topRows.requiredEvidence: Confirm memory, telemetry retries, battery capacity, sensor drift and calibration strategy.
